summary: The note is an excerpt from a novel (Book 14, part 126) in which the narrator eavesdrops from beneath the bushes on the front porch of a house during a gathering. Simon, a local activist who sells weed to friends to pay rent, is pressured by Danny into a 'security theatre' scheme after being picked up earlier by a black SUV. The narrator, wearing Jason's spy shirt, nearly gets caught when cigarette ash lands on the sleeve and Danny hears a noise, and Danny and Simon discuss needing to get 'something real going' and making connections.
one_line: The narrator eavesdrops under a porch as Danny and Simon, a cash-strapped activist, discuss a staged security scheme.
key_facts: Simon is described as a local activist old enough for the job who pays his rent by selling weed to his friends.
The narrator reasons that Simon would choose helping stage security theatre over jail.
Simon was picked up in the afternoon by a black SUV, and the narrator suspects its occupant coached him for the meeting.
Danny gives Simon a slight nod, as if they had just made a private agreement.
Danny leaves the house through the front door to go out for a smoke, and Simon follows a moment later holding a pack of cigarettes.
The narrator circles the side of the house and crawls under bushes along the foundation to reach the front porch.
Cigarette ash lands on the sleeve of Jason's expensive spy-shirt, and the narrator brushes it off hoping it has not left a hole.
Danny asks someone whether they heard something, and after a pause says it must have been a squirrel.
Simon tells Danny he will set things up and asks what Danny needs.
Danny says they need to get something real going.
Simon says of the others, 'They have the stuff, you have the skills. Boom.' and jokes 'No pun intended.'
Danny says he is happy if he can make connections.

entities.name: Danny
entities.role: figure who gives Simon a nod, leaves for a smoke, and talks with Simon on the porch about getting something real going

entities.name: Tweak
entities.role: nickname of the person Danny asks whether he has any weed left
